overallNotes: The cross-reference to Section 2.18 (within exception 6.01(b)(1)(X)) could not be resolved because the source-context budget was exhausted; it is inventoried as AMBIGUOUS_REFERENCE on item i35.

The citation 'Section 6.01(b)(1)' is used at least twice in the surrounding text with different substantive content (once as the exception itself defining branches X/Y/Z, and once as a cross-reference from exception (3)); item i43's reference to it is marked AMBIGUOUS_REFERENCE because the correct target cannot be determined from the text given.

Cross-references to Section 6.08(a)(3)(b), Section 6.08(b) and Section 6.08(b)(4) were not encountered as explicit text within this batch's slots and therefore were not inventoried as separate items; they are noted here in case they surface in later batches referencing this section.

Exception (4)(b) (introduced at the very end of slot operative:6.01(b)(4)(a)(iii)#1) is truncated at the boundary of this batch; its full content, conditions and any associated caps will need to be inventoried once the continuing slots are provided.

The Permitted Ratio Debt definition (item i33) aggregates three separately-tested ratio categories (pari passu, junior lien, unsecured) each with its own either/or ratio election; all three categories and their sub-alternatives are individually inventoried as items i14-i32.
